# shumoku Provider

Manage a [Shumoku](https://shumoku.dev) Server — topologies, data sources, credentials, topology source attachments and dashboards — through its REST API.

Authenticate with an API token (`shmk_...`) issued by a Shumoku administrator. Data sources, credentials and topology source attachments are administrator surfaces: the token needs the `admin` role (`admin:manage` permission) to manage them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    shumoku = {
      source = "shumoku-dev/shumoku"
    }
  }
}

# The endpoint and token can also come from SHUMOKU_ENDPOINT and SHUMOKU_TOKEN.
provider "shumoku" {
  endpoint = "https://shumoku.example.com"
  token    = var.shumoku_token
}

variable "shumoku_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Shumoku Server, e.g. `https://shumoku.example.com`. The provider appends `/api`. May also be set with the `SHUMOKU_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. Only for testing against servers with self-signed certificates. May also be set with `SHUMOKU_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY=true`. Defaults to `false`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token (`shmk_...`), sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. May also be set with the `SHUMOKU_TOKEN` environment variable.
